bar.rule: pass: gap >= -2 AND flagRate <= 0.02; fail: gap < -5; otherwise borderline (including a chrF-pass gap with a flag breach); gap = local chrF++ + CALIBRATION_OFFSET - published baseline; full-model rows are 'baseline' (the bar itself)
bar.calibrationNote: P1 measured the local harness vs published on the same full model at a stable -1.38 chrF++ (greedy q8, 200 of 1012 sentences vs Meta full-devtest eval); CALIBRATION_OFFSET=0 keeps the literal published comparison

sample.source: FLORES-200 devtest (Meta, CC-BY-SA 4.0), fixed ids shared across every language and direction
